# DocFlow

> DocFlow is an all-in-one web-based document and design workspace. Create professional documents, slide presentations, flowcharts, resumes, and PDF workflows directly in your browser with real-time editing, local-first privacy, and high-quality exports.

## Core Features
- **Document Editor**: Full-featured rich text editing with multi-page paginated sheets, customizable typography, mathematical formulas (LaTeX / KaTeX), tables, borders, and Markdown/HTML/PDF exports.
- **Presentation Maker**: Slide deck creator with slide layouts, geometric shapes, speaker notes, and presentation mode.
- **Flowchart & Diagram Studio**: Touch-friendly SVG diagramming canvas with node connectors and workflow modeling.
- **Resume Builder**: Professional ATS-friendly resume creation with real-time formatting.
- **PDF Tools**: In-browser PDF editing, merging, splitting, OCR text extraction, and document conversion.

## Optional / Context
- Architecture: Client-side React + TypeScript SPA with local storage persistence and zero telemetry tracking.
- Formats Supported: DOCX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, TXT, JSON, SVG, PNG, JPEG.
